title: Oxychloride modeling project
description: The manifest of a modeling project: a folder holding metamodels, constraints, models and transformations. Every document below the folder belongs to the project, except those of nested projects, hidden folders, build output and generated code. See docs/PROJECTS.md.

name.description: The project's name (default: the name of its folder).

folders.description: Where new documents of each kind go, relative to the project. Documents elsewhere in the project belong to it too.

models.description: Models: HUTN documents (.hutn) and XMI files (.xmi).

generated.description: Generated code; its documents are not part of the project.

registry.description: The project's package registry: URIs (nsURIs, or URIs other files use for a metamodel, reachable or not) and the metamodel files they stand for, relative to the project. A URI ending in '/' maps a prefix to a folder. Used by the VS Code extension and by `oxy check`.

codegen.description: How Generate Code… generates code for the project's metamodels (without asking).

outputFolder.description: The folder the code is written into, relative to the project (default: the 'generated' folder).
